title: A collection that is easy to find your way around
description: Split the plants by location, carry out group actions you can verify and keep a personal history.

blocks.text: The owner adds a plant under their own name, picks a location and saves a photograph. Similar specimens stay separate cards. A shelf or a room makes it quick to pick out the part of the collection you need.

quote.text: The database of plants is not at all extensive and there's no way to manually add a rare plant. I have more than a few that just don't exist in their list

blocks.text: To begin with, adding by hand and a clear history of actions are what help. A group action shows the plants selected and lets you exclude one; a mistake can be undone without correcting the whole set one by one.
The collection is not limited by the catalog

The reviews confirm that rare plants are not always in the catalog. So the size of the database is a secondary question for a journal. Before any complex reference features, it is worth testing that the collection moves to another device with its photographs and events.
